5790-aria-da-capo.title: Aria Da Capo
5790-aria-da-capo.creator: Edna St. Vincent Millay
5790-aria-da-capo.description: A book by Edna St. Vincent Millay. You see, I am always wanting A little more than what I have,—or else A little less. There’s something wrong. My dear, How many fingers have you? COLUMBINE: La, indeed, How should I know?—It always takes me one hand To count the other with. PIERROT: Why?—I am a student, Columbine; And search into all matters. COLUMBINE: La, indeed?— Count them yourself, then! ’Tis of no consequence.

arxiv-2101-05499.title: ECOL : E arly Det ec tion of CO VID L ies Using Content, Prior Knowledge and Source Information
arxiv-2101-05499.creator: Ipek Baris, Zeyd Boukhers
arxiv-2101-05499.description: Abstract Social media platforms are vulnerable to fake news dissemination, which causes negative consequences such as panic and wrong medication in the healthcare domain. Therefore, it is important to automatically detect fake news in an early stage before they get widely spread.

arxiv-2103-06944.title: Preregistering NLP research
arxiv-2103-06944.creator: Emiel van Miltenburg, Chris van der Lee, Emiel Krahmer
arxiv-2103-06944.description: Abstract Preregistration refers to the practice of specifying what you are going to do, and what you expect to find in your study, before carrying out the study. This practice is increasingly common in medicine and psychology, but is rarely discussed in NLP.

arxiv-2112-01969.title: Experimental Observations of the Effects of Intermolecular Van der Waals Forces on Entropy
arxiv-2112-01969.creator: Matthew David Marko
arxiv-2112-01969.description: Abstract Published in Nature Scientific Reports, 12 , 7105, 2 May 2022. http://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-022-11093-z Abstract An experimental effort was conducted to measure the change in internal energy of non-ideal carbon dioxide as its volume rapidly expanded with the sudden opening of a valve from one to two compressed gas cylinders.

arxiv-2112-09327.title: Incentivizing Collaboration in Machine Learning via Synthetic Data Rewards
arxiv-2112-09327.creator: Sebastian Shenghong Tay, Xinyi Xu, Chuan Sheng Foo, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low
arxiv-2112-09327.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel collaborative generative modeling (CGM) framework that incentivizes collaboration among self-interested parties to contribute data to a pool for training a generative model (e.g., GAN), from which synthetic data are drawn and distributed to the parties as rewards commensurate to their contributions.

arxiv-2206-12671.title: Properties of black hole vortex in Einstein’s gravity
arxiv-2206-12671.creator: F. C. E. Lima, A. R. P. Moreira, C. A. S. Almeida
arxiv-2206-12671.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by F. C. E. Lima, A. R. P. Moreira, C. A. S. Almeida. Abstract: We investigate the influence of the matter field and the gauge field on the metric functions of the AdS 3 spacetime of the Maxwell-Higgs model. By considering a matter field with a solitonic profile with the ability to adjust the field variable from kink to compact-like configurations, the appearance of black hole solutions is noticed for an event horizon at r + ≈ 1.5 r_{+}\approx 1.5 .

arxiv-2211-17078.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Truck Vehicle Routing Problems with Multi-Leg Demand Routes
arxiv-2211-17078.creator: Joshua Levin, Randall Correll, Takanori Ide, Suzuki Takafumi, Saito Takaho, Alan Arai
arxiv-2211-17078.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning (RL) has been shown to be effective in producing approximate solutions to some vehicle routing problems (VRPs), especially when using policies generated by encoder-decoder attention mechanisms. While these techniques have been quite successful for relatively simple problem instances, there are still under-researched and highly complex VRP variants for which no effective RL method has been demonstrated.

arxiv-2301-08876.title: Reconstruction of f ⁡ ( Q , T ) f(Q,T) Lagrangian for various cosmological scenario
arxiv-2301-08876.creator: Gaurav N. Gadbail, Simran Arora, P.K. Sahoo
arxiv-2301-08876.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gaurav N. Gadbail, Simran Arora, P.K. Sahoo. The variety of theories that can account for the dark energy phenomenon encourages current research to concentrate on a more in-depth examination of the potential impacts of modified gravity on both local and cosmic scales. We discuss some cosmological reconstruction in f ⁡ ( Q , T ) f(Q,T) cosmology (where Q Q is the non-metricity scalar, and T T is the trace of the energy-momentum tensor) corresponding to the evolution background in Friedmann-Laîmatre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) universe.

arxiv-2303-15700.title: Estimation of Scalar Field Distribution in the Fourier Domain Thanks: The authors are with Defence Science and Technology Group, Melbourne, Australia. E-mail: alex.leong@defence.gov.au, alexei.skvortsov@defence.gov.au
arxiv-2303-15700.creator: Alex S. Leong, Alexei T. Skvortsov
arxiv-2303-15700.description: Abstract In this paper we consider the problem of estimation of scalar field distribution (e.g. pollutant, moisture, temperature) from noisy measurements collected by unmanned autonomous vehicles such as UAVs. The field is modelled as a sum of Fourier components/modes, where the number of modes retained and estimated determines in a natural way the approximation quality.

arxiv-2305-15896.title: MixFormerV2: Efficient Fully Transformer Tracking
arxiv-2305-15896.creator: Yutao Cui Tianhui Song Gangshan Wu Limin Wang
arxiv-2305-15896.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yutao Cui Tianhui Song Gangshan Wu Limin Wang. Transformer-based trackers have achieved high accuracy on standard benchmarks. However, their efficiency remains an obstacle to practical deployment on both GPU and CPU platforms. In this paper, to mitigate this issue, we propose a fully transformer tracking framework based on the successful MixFormer tracker [ 14 ] , coined as MixFormerV2 , without any dense convolutional operations or complex score prediction modules.

arxiv-2309-00007.title: When Measures are Unreliable: Imperceptible Adversarial Perturbations toward Top- k k Multi-Label Learning Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedi
arxiv-2309-00007.creator: Yuchen Sun, Qianqian Xu, Zitai Wang, Qingming Huang
arxiv-2309-00007.description: Abstract . With the great success of deep neural networks, adversarial learning has received widespread attention in various studies, ranging from multi-class learning to multi-label learning. However, existing adversarial attacks toward multi-label learning only pursue the traditional visual imperceptibility but ignore the new perceptible problem coming from measures such as Precision@ k k and mAP@ k k .

arxiv-2311-00174.title: Dark-state solution and symmetries of the two-qubit multimode asymmetric quantum Rabi model
arxiv-2311-00174.creator: Ze-Feng Lei, Junlong Tian, Jie Peng
arxiv-2311-00174.description: Abstract We study the two-qubit asymmetric quantum Rabi model (AQRM) and find its dark-state solution. Such solutions have at most one photon and constant eigenenergy in the whole coupling regime, causing level crossings in the spectrum, although there is no explicit conserved quantity except energy.

arxiv-2412-07009.title: LUIEO: A Lightweight Model for Integrating Underwater Image Enhancement and Object Detection PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2021 IEEE
arxiv-2412-07009.creator: Bin Li, Li Li, Zhenwei Zhang, Yuping Duan
arxiv-2412-07009.description: Abstract Underwater optical images inevitably suffer from various degradation factors such as blurring, low contrast, and color distortion, which hinder the accuracy of object detection tasks. Due to the lack of paired underwater/clean images, most research methods adopt a strategy of first enhancing and then detecting, resulting in a lack of feature communication between the two learning tasks.

arxiv-2505-18321.title: A structure-preserving local discontinuous Galerkin method for the Fokker-Planck-Landau equation
arxiv-2505-18321.creator: Kun Huang, Andrés Galindo-Olarte, Rodrigo González-Hernández, Irene M. Gamba
arxiv-2505-18321.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce a structure-preserving local discontinuous Galerkin (LDG) method [ 10 ] for solving the non-local non-linear Fokker-Planck-Landau (FPL) equations. We rephrase the structure-preserving strategy of Shiroto and Sentoku [ 29 ] in the language of numerical analysis, and extend it to the LDG framework.

arxiv-2508-16490.title: Multi-agent Robust and Optimal Policy Learning for Data Harvesting
arxiv-2508-16490.creator: Shili Wu, Yancheng Zhu, Aniruddha Datta, Sean B. Andersson
arxiv-2508-16490.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shili Wu, Yancheng Zhu, Aniruddha Datta, Sean B. Andersson. We consider the problem of using multiple agents to harvest data from a collection of sensor nodes (targets) scattered across a two-dimensional environment. These targets transmit their data to the agents that move in the space above them, and our goal is for the agents to collect data from the targets as efficiently as possible while moving to their final destinations.

pmc-10737323.creator: Sukyung Yoon
pmc-10737323.description: Elder abuse is a serious social justice violation and a public health concern that impacts victims’ mental and physical health worldwide. In the U.S., about 11.7% of older adults have reported elder abuse each year, but the rate is underestimated due to underreporting (Dong, 2015).

pmc-11345367.title: Editorial: Conversation analysis and sociological theory
pmc-11345367.creator: Melisa Stevanovic, David Inglis, Emmi Koskinen, Anssi Peräkylä
pmc-11345367.description: “mainstream” sociology, sometimes being located within designated “sociology” departments, but often existing outside of them, connecting with other disciplines in creative ways. Intellectually speaking, CA has both rebelled against the parent discipline, while also being the inheritor and elaborator of some of its key themes and ideas (Heritage, 2008).

pmc-11710390.title: Midlife Neuroinflammatory Dynamics: The Emergence of Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimmune Profile in the Female Human Brain
pmc-11710390.creator: Hannah Van Rossum, Yuan Shang, Roberta Diaz Brinton
pmc-11710390.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundInflammation plays a pivotal role in driving the development and progression of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) in the human brain, offering a promising avenue for therapeutic intervention. However, the initiation phase of inflammation and its potential sex differences remain elusive.

pmc-12623204.title: Case Report: Serplulimab-induced thyroid dysfunction in a patient with advanced small cell lung cancer
pmc-12623204.creator: Lu Lu, Lingxiang Liu, Wentong Fang, Xiaojian Liu
pmc-12623204.description: Studies have shown that the application of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in solid tumors can easily affect the endocrine system, causing disorders of thyroid function, which are usually reversible after treatment cessation in most patients. Serplulimab is a PD-1 inhibitor and is used for treating small cell lung cancer (SCLC).

pmc-13122926.title: Health-related quality of life in adults with epidermolysis bullosa: a cross-sectional study in seven European countries using EQ-5D-5L
pmc-13122926.creator: Renata Linertová, Márta Péntek, Benjamín Rodríguez-Díaz, Christine Bodemer, Vinzenz Hübl, May El Hachem, Gudrun Salamon, Verónica Alonso-Ferreira, Georgi Stefanov, Ritu Jain, Yolanda Ramallo-Fariña, Lidia García-Pérez, BUR-EB Study Group
pmc-13122926.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEpidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a rare genetic disorder that causes extreme skin fragility, chronic pain, and functional impairment, with major psychosocial and economic consequences. Health-related quality of life (HRQoL) data is critical to capture the full burden of EB. Health utilities derived from preference-based generic instruments such as the EQ-5D-5L provide standardized health status utility values that enable cross-disease comparisons and provide input data for cost-utility analyses to inform resource allocation.
